The '''''Imperious''''' was a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Fel Empire]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the Empire's [[Sith–Imperial War|war]] with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], fought from [[127 ABY|127]] to [[130 ABY]]. The ''Imperious'' served as [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Morlish Veed]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] at the last major engagement of the war, the [[Battle of Caamas]], in 130 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], and was later the place of meeting between Veed, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]], and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maladi]], as they discussed plans for the future of the Empire.

==Description==
The ''Imperious'' was a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for the [[Fel Empire]].<ref name="leg8" /> The design of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] drew upon the distinctive wedge-shape of earlier [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], and featured a heavily slanted forward hull.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
The ''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer ''Imperious'' was constructed as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Morlish Veed]], and was in service in the years leading up to the [[Sith–Imperial War]]<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|II|97|''Imperious''}}</ref> of [[127 ABY|127]]&ndash;[[130 ABY]],<ref name="Legacy 0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> between the Empire and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="cswe" />

In 130 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the ''Imperious'' served as Veed's flagship at the [[Battle of Caamas]], the last major conflict of the Sith–Imperial War.<ref name="leg21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref> In the aftermath of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], just three hours after the [[Massacre at Ossus]]&mdash;which saw the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at the hands of the [[Fel Empire]]'s allies, the [[One Sith]]&mdash;newly promoted [[High Moff]] Veed, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde]], and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maladi]] met on the ''Imperious'' above [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to discuss their plans for the Empire, which called for replacing [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]. The discussion aboard the ''Imperious'' led to the [[Attack on Emperor Fel|coup]] that placed [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] on the throne and the beginning of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="leg8" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Imperious'' was the flagship of Grand Admiral Morlish Veed and, as such, was under his overall command. After Darth Krayt deposed Emperor Fel, the ''Imperious'' began its service in the new Sith Empire, remaining under Veed's command.<ref name="leg8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Imperious'' made its first appearance in the eighth issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' series, [[Legacy (2006) 8|''Allies'']], published in [[February]] [[2007]]. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Adam DeKraker]].<ref name="leg8" /> In the story arc [[Star Wars: Legacy: Indomitable|''Indomitable'']], there appears an [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|Advanced Star Destroyer]] also called [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']].<ref name="leg21" /> However, Ostrander mentioned on [[TheForce.net]]'s [[Jedi Council Forums]] that when writing ''Indomitable'', he made a mistake in naming both ships ''Imperious'', which his editor also missed before it went to print.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28299002|board=Literature|thread=My Retirement As Your Mod: The Final Prophecy (now discussing how to fix the Lit forum)|user=[[John Ostrander|jfostrander01]]|date=2008-04-08|time=6:55 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180304154605/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/my-retirement-as-your-mod-the-final-prophecy-now-discussing-how-to-fix-the-lit-forum.28269510/page-17}}</ref>
